external_entities.name: insurance partner
external_entities.description: One of three insurance partners that supplies a daily extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.
external_entities.notes: The text does not distinguish the three partners individually.

external_entities.name: analysts
external_entities.description: Analysts who query the warehouse directly.

processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: Scheduler that lists and reads the landing bucket and triggers a Spark transform job for each file.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
processes.notes: Airflow keeps connection strings and partner keys in its metadata database. It does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: Transform job that normalizes claim records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.
processes.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_stores.notes: The submitter does not know how the landing bucket is encrypted; it is described as being on defaults as far as they know.

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: Airflow metadata database holding connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: The submitter does not know whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest; it is described as being on defaults as far as they know.

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.description: Warehouse destination for normalized claim records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.

data_flows.name: push files
data_flows.description: Insurance partner pushes a daily extract into the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_flows.notes: Each partner has a static key issued during onboarding; the keys have not changed since.
data_flows.data_description: Daily extract containing claim records with member names and dates of birth.

data_flows.name: read files
data_flows.description: Airflow lists and reads files from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
data_flows.data_description: Partner extract files containing claim records with member names and dates of birth.

data_flows.name: trigger job
data_flows.description: Airflow triggers a Spark transform job for each file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.

data_flows.name: store configuration
data_flows.description: Airflow keeps connection strings and partner keys in its metadata database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.

data_flows.name: load records
data_flows.description: Spark loads normalized claim records into BigQuery.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_flows.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.
data_flows.data_description: Normalized claim records with member names and dates of birth.

data_flows.name: query warehouse
data_flows.notes: Analysts authenticate with SSO. The grant is dataset-wide and member-identifying columns have not been split out.

trust_boundaries.name: landing network
trust_boundaries.description: Network in which the Airflow scheduler runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network

trust_boundaries.name: warehouse network
trust_boundaries.description: Network in which the Spark transform job runs and analysts are located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.
trust_boundaries.notes: Analysts are also stated to be on the warehouse network.

assumptions.assumption: The claim extracts and claim-record flows are confidential because they contain health information and member-identifying names and dates of birth.
assumptions.basis: The landing bucket stores extracts containing claim records with member names and dates of birth.

assumptions.assumption: The Airflow metadata database is confidential because it stores connection strings and partner keys.
assumptions.basis: The text states that the database keeps connection strings and partner keys.

assumptions.assumption: BigQuery is confidential because it stores normalized claim records containing health and member-identifying information.
assumptions.basis: The text states that normalized claim records are loaded into BigQuery, and the extracts contain claim records with member names and dates of birth.

assumptions.assumption: The insurance partner presents health and personally identifying claim data.
assumptions.basis: The partners supply extracts containing claim records with member names and dates of birth.

assumptions.assumption: The Airflow scheduler touches health and personally identifying claim data because it reads the partner extracts.
assumptions.basis: The scheduler reads whatever is in the landing bucket, which contains claim records with member names and dates of birth.

assumptions.assumption: The Spark transform job touches health and personally identifying claim data because it normalizes the extracts.
assumptions.basis: The transform normalizes the claim records from the partner extracts.

assumptions.assumption: The scheduler-to-bucket flow carries health and personally identifying claim data.
assumptions.basis: The scheduler reads extract files containing claim records with member names and dates of birth.

assumptions.assumption: The Spark-to-BigQuery flow carries health and personally identifying claim data.
assumptions.basis: The transform loads normalized claim records into BigQuery, and the extracts contain member names and dates of birth.

assumptions.assumption: The analyst query flow carries health and personally identifying claim data.
assumptions.basis: Analysts query the warehouse, whose loaded records are claim records with member-identifying columns.

assumptions.assumption: Airflow and the Spark transform job present non-web interfaces because they are described as a scheduler and a transform job rather than web applications.
assumptions.basis: The text describes Airflow as a scheduler that wakes up, lists a bucket, reads files, and triggers jobs.

assumptions.assumption: Airflow and the Spark transform job present non-web interfaces because they are described as a scheduler and a transform job rather than web applications.
assumptions.basis: The text describes Spark as a transform job that normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery.
